title: She Knew Him When He Called Her Name
lede: Mary weeps at the empty tomb until the risen Jesus says one word — her name — and grief turns into recognition.

title: Blessed Are Your Eyes, Because They See
lede: Parables don't hide the truth so much as reveal it to a heart that's already leaning toward what's being shown.
liturgicalDay: Thursday of the Sixteenth Week in Ordinary Time

title: The Seed Doesn't Change. The Ground Does.
lede: The word is the same everywhere — what changes the harvest is the condition of the ground that receives it.
liturgicalDay: Friday of the Sixteenth Week in Ordinary Time

title: The Cup Before the Seat
lede: James and John's mother asks for the best seats in the Kingdom — Jesus answers with a question about a cup.

title: Worth Everything You Have
lede: Two short parables about the one discovery worth selling everything for.

title: Small Enough to Miss, Large Enough to Shelter
lede: A seed you could lose in your palm and a pinch of yeast you'd never notice both become impossible to miss once they've finished their work.
liturgicalDay: Monday of the Seventeenth Week in Ordinary Time

title: Why God Waits for the Harvest
lede: Jesus explains the weeds among the wheat: judgment is certain, but it belongs to the harvest, not to today.
liturgicalDay: Tuesday of the Seventeenth Week in Ordinary Time

title: Right Here, Not Someday
lede: Martha already believed in the resurrection at the end of time — Jesus asks her to believe in him, standing in front of her, right now.
liturgicalDay: Memorial of Saints Martha, Mary, and Lazarus

title: Not Yours to Sort Yet
lede: The good and the bad stay in the same net until the very end — Jesus asks not for us to sort the catch, but to keep bringing out both old wisdom and new.
liturgicalDay: Thursday of the Seventeenth Week in Ordinary Time

title: Too Familiar to Believe
lede: The people who knew Jesus longest were the ones who could see him least — Nazareth's certainty about who he was closed the door on what he wanted to do there.
liturgicalDay: Memorial of Saint Ignatius of Loyola, Priest

title: The Cost of Staying Quiet
lede: Herod already believes killing John was wrong — that's why the rumor about Jesus rattles him so badly. He did it anyway, because doing right would have cost him face in front of his guests.
liturgicalDay: Memorial of Saint Alphonsus Liguori, Bishop and Doctor of the Church

title: Compassion From an Empty Tank
lede: Jesus is grieving and exhausted, trying to get away and be alone — and still, when the crowd finds him anyway, he has compassion, heals their sick, and feeds them from almost nothing.

title: Little Faith Is Still Enough
lede: Peter was doing fine walking on water — until he looked at the wind instead of at Jesus. The moment he started sinking is also the moment Jesus was already reaching for him.
liturgicalDay: Monday of the Eighteenth Week in Ordinary Time
